unpack_qwenimage_latents: unpack denoised latents from 3D tensor to 5D tensor with QwenImageAfterDenoiseStep
unpack_layered_latents: unpack layered denoised latents from (B, seq, C*4) to (B, C, layers+1, H, W) with QwenImageLayeredAfterDenoiseStep
decode_latents_to_images: decode unpacked latents to images with QwenImageDecoderStep using AutoencoderKLQwenImage
decode_layered_images: decode layered latents into per-layer images with QwenImageLayeredDecoderStep
postprocess_images: postprocess decoded image tensors to pil, np, or pt format with QwenImageProcessImagesOutputStep
postprocess_inpaint_images: postprocess inpaint images with mask overlay using QwenImageInpaintProcessImagesOutputStep
